audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 4-5 were marked 'Skill' when they are Shen's best window, and level 6 and first item were marked 'Skill' and 'Shen' when both belong to Gragas.
audit.why: The packet chart and the already-audited mirror agree: Skill, Shen, Shen, Shen, Gragas, Gragas, Shen. Before 6, Gragas has no answer to a landed taunt; Explosive Cask at 100s and his first AP item are what take the stage back.
audit.corrected: Rows 3, 4 and 5 flipped to Shen, Gragas, Gragas in matched full/content pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer called Iceborn Gauntlet the first-item spike and treated level 6 as neutral.
audit.why: Gragas's Explosive Cask (100/85/70s) and his first AP item are the two spikes that flip this lane; Shen's item timing does not.
audit.corrected: Level-6 and first-item phase text rewritten to Gragas's spikes with real cooldowns; levels 4-5 named as Shen's window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page told the player to 'W-block his Q barrel'. Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks only, so every Gragas ability lands through the zone. Separately, nothing said that Gragas can cancel Stand United.
audit.why: Riot's text for Spirit's Refuge is 'attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked' — the only Gragas damage it denies is the Drunken Rage empowered basic attack. Stand United is a channel, so Body Slam (14s) or Explosive Cask interrupts the teleport and the shield with it.
audit.corrected: The barrel-block claim removed from spikes[0]; Refuge scoped to his attacks in the level-2 phase text; the channel cancel written into the level-6 phase text and wants.foe[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was in the itemization line but the page attributed his sustain to 'Q barrel self-healing'.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal, and the source is Happy Hour (P) — he heals periodically on ability use, not from standing in the barrel. That changes when Grievous Wounds matters: it is every cast, not just the poke.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[1] rewritten to Happy Hour with the Grievous Wounds dependency stated.

audit.why: suspectNames flagged 'Use Stand United' and 'Use Explosive Cask' — both false positives; the names are correct.

edits.before: W spirit zone blanks his auto window. Only take the trade when Gragas's Body Slam is down.
edits.after: Refuge blanks his Drunken Rage attack only. Trade when Body Slam is down — 14s at rank 1.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Body Slam's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Body Slam is 14s and Explosive Cask is not up yet — this is your window, so force the taunt trade and bank the HP lead.

edits.before: Stand United makes your lane a 1v2 for the enemy MAP — track every low ally. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Gragas's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Explosive Cask arrives on 100s and knocks you out of your own Refuge — and it cancels Stand United's channel outright. All-in only once it is spent.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Body Slam's cooldown.
edits.after: His AP item lands first — Barrel Roll poke on 6s at rank 5 outpaces what you can trade back.

edits.before: Shadow Dash comes online at 2 and your full W+E+Q pattern at 3 — taunt him into Twilight Assault range and W-block his Q barrel on the way out for a no-risk damage trade.
edits.after: Shadow Dash comes online at 2 and the full W+E+Q pattern at 3 — Refuge blocks his attacks, never Barrel Roll, so taunt him and eat the cask on Ki Barrier instead.

edits.before: Sustain his HP pool with Q barrel self-healing so your Twilight Assault trades never open a meaningful kill window
edits.after: Heal off Happy Hour on every cast, so Twilight Assault chip never opens a kill window without Grievous Wounds

edits.before: Use Explosive Cask (R) to knock you away from Spirit's Refuge during your all-in pattern and convert a counter-engage
edits.after: Cancel your Stand United channel with Body Slam or Explosive Cask, stranding the shield and the teleport both

notes: The 'W-block his Q barrel' line was the load-bearing error here — Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks, not abilities, so a player following that advice stands in a cask expecting it to be denied. Confirms the mirror's finding. The full layer still carries a similar phrasing in dosFull[2].t ('W-block his autos'), which is correct as written, so I left it.
